rules:
LLAMA 3.2 VISION-11B AS AN ADDITIONAL TRAINED BACKBONE (separate record; not part of paper 2's
preregistered backbone list, which was closed by the three-seed record a259c9e0... on 2026-09-29).
Purpose: the Llama family is represented in paper 2 only by Idefics3-8B (Llama-3.1 language model,
SmolVLM2 image policy), whose metre-only adapter is untestable on the test clips. This run asks whether
the paper's rules replicate on Meta's own vision model of that family, which injects the image through
cross-attention rather than through visual tokens in the sequence. Intended for the follow-up paper, or
for a revision of paper 2 if a reviewer asks; whichever use, the verdicts are reported as computed.

MODEL. meta-llama/Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct (model_type mllama; Llama-3.2-11B language model with 8 cross-attention layers,
ViT-H/14 vision encoder). Weights: the byte-identical ModelScope mirror
LLM-Research/Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct (Meta's gated Hugging Face repo rejected the access request
on 2026-10-05; the licence is accepted by use and shipped with the mirror). Snapshot pin = sha256 over
the sorted "path sha256" lines of the 18 repository files outside original/ (config.json sha256
db708a72a246253fdf8aa3837a5f0b80ac1960692495ce05cb3101833128e845):
  a99bf12aac301325dae596ebc1b094eb42c81502a96aad47106b02bb099c779b
a100/llama32_runner.py refuses to start unless base_models/llama32_11b_vision/MODELSCOPE_MANIFEST.json
reproduces this pin and every shard's sha256.

PROTOCOL. The round-2 protocol (results/courtdyn/backbone2_r2/PREREGISTRATION.json, rules_sha256
003f2e1a80e4153cced6a2b512c1aee3bb9fd936ceea821ab8dcea07d3b1c7a4) applies verbatim, with
backbone2_r2 read as backbone_llama32/llama32_11b_vision, and with the fourth-backbone record's differences (a)-(e)
(results/courtdyn/backbone4_a100/PREREGISTRATION.json, rules_sha256
eecca80879ffe4f417dbd6aead881c7b6bb788a87364ba5f08e0390f52f3c05e): fresh unadapted-backbone cells and base
text probe; same pools, recipe (lr 1e-4, cosine, warmup 0.03, grad_accum 16, LoRA r 16 alpha 32 dropout
0.05 on the language model's q/k/v/o/gate/up/down projections, vision model and projector frozen, NF4
double-quantised base with bf16 compute, paged 8-bit AdamW, nf4 evaluation, greedy decoding, 128 new
tokens), 4-epoch schedule (70 optimizer steps per epoch), the same 280-item Q1_side dev set and STOPPING
RULE at seed 42 (k* = smallest k with parse rate >= 0.90 AND >= 5 distinct parsed answers in each family
for the metre-only adapter; otherwise k* = 4, "degenerate at the cap"), the mixed-unit adapter at the
same k*, the same test cells and arms (explicit m/cm/px, first-frame x4 on the metre arm, in-template
m/cm, both test clips), the same 392-item text probe, R1, R3, R4 as round 1 and R2 as amended in round 2
(R >= 10 AND rho(cm answers, reference) >= 0.30), the same degeneracy readings. Training through
train/train_durable.py (checkpoint every 10 steps) and train/train_qlora_llama32.py ->
train_qlora_family.py -> the frozen train/train_qlora.py; evaluation through tools/llama32_launch.py ->
family_launch.py -> the frozen a100/eval_controls.py. The only new code is the family entry
(a100/family_policy_llama32.py) and these two thin wrappers; nothing hashed into receipts changes.

IMAGE POLICY (pinned, identical in training and evaluation, checked fail-closed on the loaded
processor): max_image_tiles = 1 (processor default 4), tile 560x560. A 960x540 frame becomes one
560x315 view padded to the tile: 1,601 vision tokens per frame on the cross-attention side, 176k px per
frame = 88% of Qwen's 200,704-px cap, between Pixtral's 147k and Gemma's 896x896. With the default
4 tiles the 16:9 frame would be split and the 4-frame item would carry up to 25k vision tokens, beyond
every other family. The text sequence carries one <|image|> token per frame, images before the question.
LoRA target names in mllama cover both the self-attention and the cross-attention projections of the
language model; the cross-attention gates are not Linear and stay frozen. This is a property of the
architecture, recorded here, not a deviation from the recipe.

THREE SEEDS, as the three-seed record (results/courtdyn/backbone_seeds3/PREREGISTRATION.json,
rules_sha256 a259c9e07ecf2b095fcf67ae66113dbb8addcc53e7e91041cecfb725042bf2cb): seed 42 runs the full
protocol including the dev stopping rule; seeds 43 and 44 run with the schedule FIXED to the seed-42 k*
(dev rule not re-run; step-k dev answers recorded descriptively), unadapted-backbone cells and base probe
reused from seed 42, all on the same A100-40GB. Labels across seeds per rule, exactly the three-seed
record's: holds at all three seeds; holds at two of three seeds (replicates at 2, fails at none); fails
across seeds (fails at >= 2, replicates at none); seed-dependent (replicates at >= 1 and fails at >= 1);
not established (anything else). Judged by tools/analyze_backbone_replication.py with this record's
directories as roots and tools/aggregate_backbone_seeds.py's label function; no new rule.

ORDER AND GATES. Runs unattended after the A100's current queue (Smol seeds 43/44, Pixtral seed 44,
Idefics3 seeds 43/44, UnitDyn pilot). Before any protocol stage: (1) a CPU preflight (config, processor
with the pinned policy, a 4-image chat-template encoding) and (2) the disclosed smoke test of the
fourth-backbone record (e) (2-step scratch training with an interruption and resume, 4 dev items with the
bare backbone, one probe item with the scratch adapter), written under $A100_WORK/smoke/llama32_11b_vision. If either
fails the run stops and is reported as not run; nothing is substituted and nothing is tuned.

NOT PART OF THIS RECORD: RTC, the hidden-state probe, soccer zero-shot. Nothing about the title, abstract
or claims of paper 2 depends on this record unless the authors later decide to include it, in which case
the inclusion is itself recorded.
snapshot_pin_method: sha256 of '\n'.join(sorted(f'{path} {sha256}')) over the repository files outside original/, sha256 per file as reported by the ModelScope files API and verified after download (a100/fetch_modelscope_model.py)
note: Local record, not externally timestamped. Written 2026-10-05 while the weights were still downloading; all paper-2 seed-42/43 outcomes and Gemma/InternVL/Qwen2.5 seed-44 outcomes were known; no Llama 3.2 Vision output of any kind existed.
